rationales.technologyReadiness: Durable runs, retries, verified-source discovery, document packaging, and human-action queues have broad local coverage; external execution remains disabled.
rationales.workflowValue: The agent removes repetitive discovery, verification, tailoring, and tracking work while preserving consequential decisions for the user.
rationales.userReadiness: The guided flow and Needs You queue have browser coverage, but a controlled multi-user usability pilot has not yet produced retained outcome evidence.
rationales.dataReadiness: A structured vault and provenance model exist, but applied tenant database controls and production data-quality measurements remain unverified.
rationales.expectedBusinessValue: Time saved and better-qualified applications are plausible, but interview and placement lift has not yet been measured in a representative pilot.
rationales.securityPrivacyGovernanceRisk: The workflow handles resumes, contact data, employment history, consent, and potential employer transmission, so governance and consequence risks are high even with fail-closed controls.

answers.userProblem: Job seekers spend substantial time finding current roles, checking direct-employer requisitions, tailoring documents, and tracking blocked applications.
answers.automationEvidence: The workflow contains repetitive bounded tasks and the repository has deterministic fixture coverage; real-user time-saved and outcome evidence is still unknown.
answers.requiredData: Verified candidate facts, preferences, employment and education history, reusable answers, job requirements, document versions, approvals, and receipt evidence.
answers.agentReadScope: Only tenant-owned confirmed facts, explicit preferences, verified direct-employer job content, current workflow state, and the exact document package required for the step.
answers.agentChangeScope: It may update internal search, verification, package, queue, and tracker state; employer-facing transmission and submission remain separately gated and disabled.
answers.humanApproval: Personal-data transmission, final submission, ambiguous facts, OTP, CAPTCHA, identity verification, unusual certifications, conflicts, and consequential uncertainty require the user.
answers.safeFailure: It preserves durable state, marks retry or Needs You, prevents ambiguous retransmission, continues unrelated safe work, and never counts submission without authoritative receipt evidence.
answers.pauseOrRevoke: The user can pause the mission, revoke consent or authorization, sign out sessions, and block new execution; started ambiguous external actions remain review-only rather than retried.
answers.costPerUser: Unknown until controlled pilot telemetry measures discovery, model, rendering, storage, notification, and worker usage by category without recording personal content.
answers.costPerOperation: Configured monetary caps exist for AI and application packaging, but actual blended per-operation cost is unverified and other external categories remain disabled.
answers.successMeasurement: Measure qualified verified roles, package completion, Needs You resolution time, authoritative receipts, interviews, user time saved, false matches, cost, and safety exceptions.
answers.removalCriteria: Remove or narrow the feature if it cannot maintain truthful receipts, tenant isolation, direct-source accuracy, safe approval boundaries, acceptable cost, or measurable user value.

evidence: Local web release suite passed with 56 public assets and 41 API functions.
Thirty-six browser scenarios passed, including consent, unknown outcomes, receipt counting, retry, Pause, and Play again.
Production RLS, restore, alert delivery, representative user outcomes, and per-operation cost remain unknown.
blockers: Applied tenant database grants and RLS have not been verified in staging.
Backup/PITR configuration and an isolated restore drill are not verified.
Representative controlled-pilot value, cost, and safety evidence is absent.
notes: This assessment authorizes no deployment, employer interaction, personal-data transmission, or final submission.
